maps.occupants: Reefsong Whalelet · Benevolent / Common; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
maps.story: A broad amphitheater faces the whalelets’ open water. Dry recording decks, resonance stakes and a sheltered instrument balcony create an aid loop around the current.
maps.activity: Place three resonance stakes, then record one complete song.
maps.recovery: Whalewatch shelter; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: Outer Sluiceway
maps.occupants: Silt Skitter · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
maps.story: A long sluice alternates dry maintenance bays and visible water channels. Tool chests, pipe bridges and hoist platforms connect the grounding straps to an upper service road.
maps.activity: Service three distinct grounding straps and sign off at the outer gauge.
maps.recovery: Sluice inspection booth; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: Gate Eel Narrows
maps.occupants: Tidal Gate Eel · Hostile / Common; optional local encounter.
maps.story: Parallel wet lanes stop at dry gate plinths. Raised contacts, maintenance stairs and a fixed overhead gantry always leave a route outside an electric pulse.
maps.activity: Close two damaged contacts after surviving clearly signalled pulses.
maps.recovery: Dry gate-inspection deck; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: Stormtide Terraces
maps.occupants: Stormshell Skitter · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
maps.story: Storm shutters and shell screens divide two retreat terraces. An anchored repair gantry stays behind the shell-chip lanes; rigging leads to a weather lookout.
maps.activity: Rebuild three storm screens and remove loose conductive shell fragments.
maps.recovery: Stormwatch shelter; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: Blackwater Reef
maps.occupants: Blackwater Pincer · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
maps.story: Dark reef teeth frame small refuge islands with clear landing edges. Pressure gauges sit above the pincer lane; a lit rescue-rope route bypasses each pocket.
maps.activity: Recover three pressure gauges; fights are avoidable on the repair route.
maps.recovery: Reef rescue beacon; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: Pressurehall Passage
maps.occupants: Bellowshell Crawler · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
maps.story: Three bellows chambers are separated by relief galleries. Valve decks, maintenance carts and hanging service cradles stay behind the marked steam discharge lanes.
maps.activity: Vent three separate chambers without entering the discharge lanes.
maps.recovery: Relief-gallery cabin; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: Maelstrom Causeway
maps.occupants: Riptide Coil · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
maps.story: A fixed inner service ring circles the vortex. Mooring winches, mast decks and cargo cradles create outer exploration routes; pull lanes end at broad dry stops.
maps.activity: Reset three mooring winches while keeping out of marked pull lanes.
maps.recovery: Mooring house; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: First Pearl Shoals
maps.occupants: Pearlglass Sentinel · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
maps.story: Luminous fossil plates make broad landings around the sentinel pockets. Prism desks and fixed survey frames provide cover; a shell stair links each reflective terrace.
maps.activity: Realign three prism plates; reflective phases are visible from safe cover.
maps.recovery: Pearlwatch refuge; a dry refuge on this same map.

maps.name: Worldtide Confluence
maps.occupants: Confluence Eel; optional Group boss The Undertow Regent (120) · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
maps.story: Three channel anchors belong to the outer solo loop. A separately marked inner gate leads to the Regent; service galleries and rescue ropes remain outside its arena.
maps.activity: Stabilize three channel anchors for solo completion; the boss occupies an optional inner ring.
maps.recovery: Confluence service refuge; a dry refuge on this same map.
